First night: Think of all your possessions: your house (if you own one); your furniture; your clothing; your jewels; your kitchen; your books and recordings. Third night: Offer into the flames every desire you want others to fulfill for you: even such things as their consideration and respect.
Fourth night: Offer up all pride of pedigree, position, skill in anything, and the respect you receive from others. You are so much more than all of these: why limit yourself to such petty self-definitions?
Fifth night: Try to offer up every self-definition, including gender, age, nationality, race, job, and ability.
